■ Stage Direction
Enchanted/Mesmerized

■ Stage Direction
Mimics telephone ringing tone with voice

■ Stage Direction
In an operator tone

■ Stage Direction
SFX: Coconut cracking open

■ Stage Direction
Lost in the moment/sentiment

★ Request
Image of rubber boots placed on the ground.

■ Stage Direction
Inhales like a martial arts master

Without understanding what on earth was going on,
I was forcibly roped into a treasure hunt...
As instructed, I decided to set the coconut down on the ground.

Is your problem on a global scale, dear customer?
Or maybe a planetary scale? Or perhaps a cosmic scale?

Obviously somethin' treasure-like, ya dummy!
Stop thinking and just feel it!
—Hm?

Gold Ship has been making a racket like this ever since we got here.
What in the world is she actually looking for?

Aah... the scent of commercial fishing...
Memories of deep-sea tuna boats from bygone days are rushing back...
(Crack crack crack crack!!)

Whoa there, this ain't cosmic at all—it's an extremely,
teensy-weensy, microscopic personal problem!
*sniff sniff*...

For every single question asked,
we'll throw in two whole troubles absolutely free~♪

And over here is...
—There it is! The staple of treasure hunting: the mysterious rubber boot!
...Hm? Whatcha lookin' over here for, punk?
*Inhaaaale*...

—Wait, what the heck am I doing?!
This ain't the time to soak in nostalgia! I gotta search for treasure!!

Woohoo~♪ That's the exact treasure I've been lookin' for!!
Put that on the ground right now!!

I get how you feel, buuut~...
Lookin' without permission is a no-no☆
In other words, somewhere on Earth.

Th-That is...!! The soothing tropical fruit of legends...!!
Are you some kinda genius or what?!
Just then, I noticed a coconut rolling around nearby.

One-two! One-two!
Warm-up: complete!!

Listen up, there's some crazy-awesome treasure here.
Something that'll make me the strongest Umamusume without a doubt!
More importantly, you haven't forgotten why we came here, right?

It's about time we take a break.
Here, have a seat, Trainer.

...Whoooaaa?!
Whooooooooooaaaaaa?!

Warming up is essential before any treasure hunt!
You make sure to stretch properly too!

Marchin' on, marchin' on, wherever we go~~♪
Come on out, come on out, treasuuure~~♪

Woohoo~! It's completely full of holes! Put a hundred people in and it'd sink in a flash!
Flooding guaranteed in this condition!

Now I'm even more clueless about what to search for...
Should I just hand over whatever's lying around?

Now, now, don't panic!
I don't remember the way back either, but as long as we're on Earth, we'll get home eventually!

An unfamiliar place, a bizarre Umamusume, warming up before a treasure hunt...
I don't even understand what's happening anymore.

...Alright, stand back.
From here on out, it's way too dangerous for an amateur...

Finding it is our whole mission today,
so make sure you search for real, okay?!

Listen up, this is where we ended up after taking an animal trail behind Tracen Academy,
passing through a cave, and crossing a jungle...

Wait, have you even been listening to me?
Hello? Hello? Hellloooooo~?

...I had my doubts,
but it seems this really was the right answer for Gold Ship.

Ah, I figured it out☆
You were mesmerized by Golshi-chan's pure cuteness, weren'tcha♪

Phew............
Heh, split right down the middle.

Fine, fine, if you insist.
For that much, I'll tell you practically for free out of pure goodwill.

Alright then, treasure hunt start~♪
*drumroll-fanfare*~! Let me know the second you find the treasure~!

A call! You've reached the
"Golshi-chan All-Purpose Consultation Center" speaking.
Ring-a-ling-a-ling, ring-a-ling-a-ling♪
And then, a few hours later—
Oho, a beat-up canoe spotted right over here~!
I took the coconut and decided to sit down on some driftwood... (To be continued)
—HWATAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!

Gold Ship just cracked open the rock-hard coconut with her bare hands!
What fearless mental fortitude and unfathomable strength...!
